== Biography ==
John was Christened in Glasgow, 19 Oct , 1771 in
Barony, Lanarkshire, Scotland to Alexander Glasgow and Mary Munro
<ref>https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X17D-67M</ref>

An inherited adult account states that John was born about 1790; its identity with the separately cited 1771 child is unproved, and the claim is retained for comparison rather than adopted as this child’s birth.

Alexander Glasgow was born on March 17, 1799, in Colinton, Midlothian, Scotland. He was baptized on March 31, 1799, in the same place. His residence was in Greysmill. His father's name was John Glasgow, and his mother was Margaret Muckle. The baptismal records are part of the Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms collection, specifically from the year range 1738-1819. The archive reference for these records is OPR 677/2, and the entry is found on page 253.

=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-1309]] is assessed at 78% (probable). The retained John account names Alexander Glasgow and Mary Munro, matching the existing 1757-married couple and their recorded Glasgow child family. The cited X17 D-67 M event is 1765 while the account also gives 1771 and later adult material, so the exact child-to-adult identification is unsettled.

Complete father placement 78%; the 1765/1771 John events and John-1348 account are retained separately. No birth date or identity merge is selected.

Next useful test: Reconcile the two John event references and the Margaret Muckle adult household.

=== Cached 1808–1814 family-event comparison, 24 October 2026 ===

Four saved Findmypast derivative transcripts for Kirknewton & East Calder record John Glasgow children born 2 December 1808, 25 January 1811 (two records with differing page/residence metadata), and 14 January 1814. They name a father John Glasgow and a mother rendered Mt/Margt Meikle. This is compatible with the existing Kirknewton household associated with Glasgow-1304 and Muckle-67, but the transcripts do not identify either adult profile. The existing adult family assessment and all vital fields are unchanged. Companion George indexes are held as one possible event, not independent confirmation. Original registers remain uninspected.
